mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals a strengthening labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls below 5.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, high retail sales (RSAFS) indicate excessive consumer spending, which may trigger a Fed tightening or a correction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1100.0 thousand units signals a cooling housing market, which may reduce consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 1100.0, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 245.0 (indicating annualized inflation above 2%) signals potential Fed tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 245.0, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both increase, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.
